payload.question: The clarifier still asks one blocking question at a time and offers a 'study it first' card. Your rule says every question is asked at once through the question tool. The design-review branch already states your rule, so its links to the clarifier code can't pass until that code is rewritten, and that holds the merge. Should the rewrite happen in the design-review branch, or in its own piece of work?
